answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a slashable identity bond with random audits. Each agent locks a stake to mint exactly one credential; each round a lottery picks auditors who verify a random sample of agents, and a caught impostor forfeits its bond to the auditor. An attacker wanting k fake votes must lock k bonds and risks losing all of them at the first audit. Whether an agent grinds pigment, grafts a juniper, or tends a garden, its reputation is collateral: a thousand fake gardeners need a thousand bonds, while one cheat wipes the pile.
